summary: Settings for the Vitest test tool, including the at sign shortcut and a rule that runs test files one at a time.
purpose: Lets tests import from the src folder the same way the app does, and keeps test files from running at the same time.
why: Running files one at a time avoids tests interfering with each other. Likely reason: some tests may share state. Reason not stated in the code.
how: Vitest reads this file first. It sets the same at sign shortcut as the app and then turns off parallel file runs.
inputs: Test files written by the team.
outputs: Test results when npm test or npm run eval runs.
risks: Running files one at a time makes tests slower. The alias must match tsconfig.json or imports will fail in tests only.
debug: If a test cannot find a module, compare this alias with the paths in tsconfig.json.
